name: Yahoo News: Daily News For You

ios.desc:
Yahoo News: News that gets you. That means unlimited access to the stories and topics that matter most to you. Whether you prefer listening to audio, watching videos or reading articles, we aggregate news from a broad spectrum of premium publishers, so you can keep up with your world through a feed personalized to your interests and preferences. Never miss out on breaking world or national news updates, plus read about entertainment, lifestyle and more.

Yahoo News has been bringing readers the latest headlines and hottest trends from trusted sources for over 20 years. Join the millions of people who get personalized news updates from Yahoo News, and access the following benefits.

Yahoo News Features: 

PERSONALIZATION: Keep up with the news you care about through a personalized feed that adapts to your interests, while helping you stay informed with the most important breaking headlines. Instantly access the stories, topics and publishers that matter most to you, and adjust your preferences at any time to improve your feed and notifications. Block any keywords or specific publishers you don’t want to hear from, and make your news feed uniquely yours. 

PREMIUM NEWS SOURCES: Yahoo News aggregates content from the best global publishers — from CNN and Time to Business Insider, People and Esquire — so you can feel confident that you have access to the best, and most comprehensive news providers out there. Get perspectives from a broad range of publishers, and opt into updates from your favorites.

UNLIMITED ACCESS: Access unlimited stories from premium publishers, so you can always stay on top of the topics you care about.

TRENDING VIDEOS: Whether you’re looking for can’t-miss shorts or trending video journalism, we aggregate only the highest quality videos, so you can watch and scroll without the noise. 

MORNING AUDIO DIGESTS: Listen to the Morning Briefing, an AI-generated audio digest that allows you to learn about the day’s most important headlines while you read, get ready, commute or multitask.  

BREAKING NEWS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Get global breaking news headlines that matter to you, wherever you are. Yahoo News partners with international news organizations like Associated Press, Reuters and The Washington Post, that report on the biggest world stories and current events. You’ll never miss a beat.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yahoo.mobile.client.android.yahoo
